name: What is the difference between kitchen cabinet replacement and cabinet refacing?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between kitchen cabinet replacement and cabinet refacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet replacement involves tearing out the entire existing cabinet box and installing brand-new units, while refacing keeps the cabinet boxes and replaces only the doors, drawer fronts, and veneer. Refacing costs less and creates less disruption, but it only updates aesthetics. Full replacement allows you to change your kitchen layout, add deep drawers, fix structural or water damage inside the boxes, and maximize ceiling height. If your current cabinet boxes are warped, moldy, or poorly arranged, replacement is the better long-term choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement removes and installs entire new cabinet boxes and doors, allowing layout changes, while refacing only updates exterior doors and veneers on existing boxes.
